stemMd: A conservation group protected more hectares of habitat this year, but the average size of its protected sites fell. Which fact best explains this?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The sites contain several plant species.

options.label: C
options.textMd: It added many small sites whose combined area exceeded the previous year's additions.

options.label: E
options.textMd: The group published a longer report.

explanationMd: The average depends on both total area and number of sites. Adding many small parcels can increase protected hectares while lowering area per site. There is no contradiction between a larger total and a smaller average.

distractorRationale.a: Species variety does not determine average area.
distractorRationale.b: Location does not explain the numerical relationship.
distractorRationale.d: Branding is irrelevant to protected area.
distractorRationale.e: Report length does not establish site count or area.
